title: Causal Inference under Dynamic Selection: Time-Varying Covariates and Latent Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2609.17170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study dynamic treatment effects in panel data under staggered adoption when treatment timing depends jointly on unobserved time-invariant heterogeneity and time-varying pretreatment covariates, including lagged outcomes. Untreated potential outcomes follow a nonparametric dynamic panel model that allows flexible interactions between time-varying covariates and latent heterogeneity. I use pretreatment outcome histories to find individuals with similar time-invariant latent factors, and the key requirement is that these histories are sufficiently informative about those latent factors. I develop an identification strategy for the dynamic average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) and propose kernel-based doubly robust estimators for the dynamic ATT. translated_title: 动态选择下的因果推断：时变协变量与潜在异质性
translated_abstract: 我研究了交错采用情形下面板数据中的动态处理效应，其中处理时点同时取决于不可观测的时不变异质性和时变的处理前协变量（包括滞后结果变量）。未处理状态下的潜在结果服从一个非参数动态面板模型，该模型允许时变协变量与潜在异质性之间存在灵活的交互作用。我利用处理前的结果历史来寻找具有相似时不变潜在因子的个体，其关键要求是这些历史信息对该潜在因子具有充分的信息量。我为动态平均处理效应（ATT）提出了识别策略，并为动态ATT提出了基于核方法的双稳健估计量。我进一步将双重交叉拟合与欠光滑相结合，并证明在适当的正则性条件下，所提出的估计量具有√n一致性、渐近正态性等性质。
tldr: 该论文针对处理时点同时受不可观测时不变异质性和时变协变量（含滞后结果）影响的交错采用面板数据，提出了动态ATT的非参数识别策略与基于核的双稳健估计量，并通过双重交叉拟合与欠光滑证明了估计量的√n一致性和渐近正态性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an identification strategy and kernel-based doubly robust estimators for dynamic ATT in staggered adoption panels where treatment timing depends on both latent time-invariant heterogeneity and time-varying covariates, establishing √n-consistency and asymptotic normality through double cross-fitting and undersmoothing.
